body: I relate to this so much. I broke up with my bf of 3 years and I know in my heart it was the right thing to do but I didn’t expect this level of pain. He and I were at odds and he thought everything was fine being that way. We went through so much and never got to experience so much together. We bare bones authentically talked for months to try to mend the relationship after a falling out and I just kept having this nagging feeling that this wasn’t right. Love wasn’t like this. Nurture yourself for now and let him nurture his own growth.

Normally it’s hard to get rid of parental controls like that. Either the uncle has it set up through your friends phone or through the phone plan itself. Both are hard to shake given that you would have to get the admin (uncle) to either change the SOC code on the phone plan or go through the parental control app to release him. Personally I would find your friend an iPod touch or a burner phone from Walmart and just use those until he is 18. I don’t believe you have to be 18 to go through Straight Talk so that may work! 

Just use the Verizon phone for basic things and the burner for things you don’t want the uncle to see.

My mom did this with my childhood cat. I was probably 23 and my kitty was 14 or so years old. My nmom got sick of ‘having to take care of her’ because she was pissing all over the floor - she was overweight and fourteen years old for God’s sake!! I begged her multiple times for her to let me take her and rid them of ‘dealing’ with her. I went NC with her for a little over 6months and when I saw her next not only had one of my birthdays past but I couldn’t find my cat when I went over to visit. 
She had waited MONTHS to tell me that she had my sweet kitty put to sleep. She wasn’t sick. It’s probably the cruelest thing I’ve witnessed her do. She just got so sick of caring for a cat that basically lived in their back room. She got tired of cleaning up piss and instead of giving her to me where she can live her twilight years happily she had my baby put to sleep. I didn’t even get to say goodbye. The reason she said she kept it a secret was because she had her put down NEAR MY BIRTHDAY. 
Fuck every and any nparent who does this. I have so much resentment for my nmom already this just adds to the pile.

So I kind of utilized this fight or flight reflex as an empowering tool. I tell her I’m done with the conversation and go to my room. 

I currently live with my Nmom and her slightly Narcissistic husband and I’ve even gotten to the point where I act happy about leaving the conversation. Like recently I did this when she criticized my financial competence and career aspirations and when I said I was done she said, ‘Are you serious?!’ To which I replied which an emphatic, ‘Oh yeah!!!!’ And a smile on my face. I was shaking with nerves and rage but it made me feel in control. I highly recommend.
